sections.heading: Welcome to City of Testimonies Ministries
sections.subheading: Every life has a testimony waiting to be told.
sections.body:
City of Testimonies Ministries is a prophetic ministry based in Monrovia, Liberia, with a mandate to reach the nations through the Word of God, deliverance, prayer, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

We believe that no matter where you are in your journey, God is still writing your story. What you may be facing today can become the testimony you share tomorrow.
